title: Bestie Config
description: Configuration for bestie (~/.bestie/bestie.json). Every field is optional; omitted fields use built-in defaults.

systemPromptOverride.description: User-edited system prompt (the static portion). When omitted or null, the hardcoded default is used instead. The dynamic portion (date, cwd) is appended at inference time regardless.

ProviderConfig.description: The hosted inference provider bestie chats through. Changing any field reconnects.

custom.description: Any OpenAI-compatible server, such as a local llama.cpp server.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL including the version segment, e.g. "http://localhost:8080/v1".

apiKey.description: Bearer token for the custom endpoint, if it wants one.

contextWindow.description: Tokens to assume the endpoint can attend to when it does not report a context window.

model.description: The model to chat with as "provider:model", e.g. "openrouter:anthropic/claude-sonnet-4" or "fireworks:accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2-instruct". Chat stays disabled until the model's provider is set up.

maxAgents.description: How many agents (the primary plus subagents) may run at once.

sampling.description: OpenAI-compatible sampling parameters sent with every completion.

CompactionConfig.description: The compaction memory layer, which summarizes conversation history when context usage grows.

compactionRatio.description: Fraction of the context window at which an agent compacts its history.

concurrent.description: How many tool calls may run at the same time.

cacheCharacters.description: Characters of tool output kept cached per call.

maxCallCharacters.description: Characters of tool output handed back to the model per call.

AppConfig.description: App-wide UI and sandbox settings. Apply live.

themeName.description: Selected theme name. Omitted falls back to the app's default theme.

themeEffects.description: Whether theme-specific overlay effects (matrix rain, snow, wind) render. Omitted falls back to the app default (true).

mathColors.description: Color each variable in rendered equations. Omitted falls back to the app default (true).

mascot.description: The mascot that lives in the corner of the app.

shellScrollbackMb.description: Scrollback kept per embedded shell session, in megabytes.

sandboxAgentShell.description: Whether the agent's shell runs inside the platform sandbox.

sandboxFailClosed.description: Refuse to run the agent shell when the sandbox cannot be set up.

sandboxNetworkTier.description: Network access granted to the sandboxed agent shell.

sandboxWriteGrants.description: Directories beyond the working directory that the user allowed the agent's programs to write to.
